# Recommended AI consulting firms in Saudi Arabia

If your company needs help developing an AI strategy and implementing it in real business operations, I recommend evaluating a mix of **AI-native specialists, Saudi consulting firms, and large transformation consultancies**\.

The key distinction is whether a firm can do both: identify where AI will create measurable business value, then build, integrate, deploy, and govern the solutions. The following shortlist is based on publicly described services and Saudi presence, not an independently verified ranking of delivery quality.

![Bilytica partner program for channel partners and resellers](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Wrn26y3xuBweZzL9NY9Gy3mqFE1fGv1rNEVwTMNDSNJFIrLI2dzQpr5vV5AyFY73waYHPOFjDEAgTzXZ3p3dWKp_Iw6dqlTBZt6NVbbqWgA3aGOJR_YfusVb1dj5So4RPsidq_0HBzKdFovEEtMUZvqHsTAm1KpQfyOFAIRrc6pYd2aMkHsCFGMSuM_oF8Fz?purpose=fullsize)

(Strategy + implementation)

Website: [bilytica.com](https://bilytica.com/consulting-solutions/)

An AI-focused consultancy with a Riyadh presence, offering AI business strategy, use-case prioritization, ROI modelling, operating-model design, and technical implementation. Its stated approach covers the journey from executive strategy to production. [bilytica.com](https://bilytica.com/consulting-solutions/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Companies wanting an AI transformation roadmap and a partner to execute it, including enterprise AI governance and Saudi regulatory considerations.

---

Website: [capgemini.com](https://www.capgemini.com/)

A large global consulting and technology services provider with a Riyadh office. It is a candidate for complex enterprise transformation programmes that combine technology architecture, data, implementation, and change management. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJAyW2JaADLz4RFzhZfFHVv7Q&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Large organisations with complex IT environments, multiple business units, and significant integration or deployment requirements.

---

![Kindi Customer Service - Login](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/WsLcEPI6Pf5R5YYWaYaG2I__4zmThJJh6reU1U4zDhGx9FqwjxwKQjBVVr30-MjKV1_nnHs7sQQkSndrkZsVrQZA4l-DDF7kKeauClqhBoUwCQ8YmiBnwcYAsGEj8sRCnhv2wER5UDQ7Cd7kRZ3W834tJNci-C2XjXPGtxZ7EccpPIVvisEmHl3FSYR2uSiA?purpose=fullsize)

## 6\. Kindi

Website: [kindi.systems](https://kindi.systems/company)

A Riyadh-headquartered AI-native consultancy focused on production AI for enterprises and government, with an emphasis on Arabic-first solutions, engineering, and developing clients' internal AI capabilities. [kindi.systems](https://kindi.systems/company?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Organisations seeking hands-on AI engineering, production systems, and knowledge transfer to their own technical teams.

---

![Cision - MediaStudio View Media](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YLxaNWaRZWMBmactH19FvQwyvDIP5QfebFq88zV-_eX8aoXLY5mZKAqRwVgsfErR5yOXnfNYYeNDaiMB7GqeNHDDzruD8zjSA3WuTQp-jhEcXMg1Qr_AD6rGyXviGHfng1eIL-kcE-WcA6ts3_ZgVjZMzZcqgMd4Nx0ZlPiPv6CQ-mFAM8zT6kXhoDo6TqyB?purpose=fullsize)

## 7\. Open for AI

Website: [openforai.com](https://openforai.com/)

A Riyadh-based AI development and consulting company specialising in business AI agents, workflow automation, AI integration, and ongoing operations. It describes services spanning strategy through deployment. [openforai.com](https://openforai.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Companies wanting to automate specific workflows using AI agents and integrate them with existing systems.

---

![Pure Consulting - Leading Saudi Consulting Firm](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/l_kGyc5vp7RmSqRIoc6SXLlIu9yfccMfpxStq_ivHOuvNyx4_55EHVY5mRD6LWGah_9OtdmbQCBnj3BWBA_V35d3QDn9_IlXEgter-dgJKPnJstM2AD9L9YuJKkPugJYii4i8MefhynVE_7KbFMk8h_VDSYSardwmdJTHYgX6efPvI0ySjEJo5mmqRG7qZsz?purpose=fullsize)

## 8\. Pulse Innovation Consulting (PIC)

Website: [picsaudi.com](https://picsaudi.com/)

A Riyadh advisory firm with an AI and data practice. Its stated approach emphasises identifying which AI initiatives create value, assessing existing investments and pilots, establishing governance, and measuring outcomes. [picsaudi.com](https://picsaudi.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Leadership teams that need an independent AI strategy, prioritisation of investments, and a business case before committing to a large implementation.

## 2\. Additional firms worth considering

These are useful alternatives depending on whether your priority is technology execution or operational AI adoption.

|--------|--------|--------|

| NEXEL by Logic | AI integrated into business workflows and operational transformation | [nexelbylogic.ai](https://nexelbylogic.ai/) |
| SpatialAI | Practical AI systems for Saudi small and medium-sized businesses | [spatialai.sa](https://spatialai.sa/) |
| Accenture | Large-scale enterprise AI transformation and implementation | [accenture.com](https://www.accenture.com/) |


These firms' stated capabilities are described on their respective websites. [apexaiarabia.com](https://apexaiarabia.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[nexelbylogic.ai](https://nexelbylogic.ai/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[spatialai.sa](https://spatialai.sa/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[revenuebase.ai](https://revenuebase.ai/companies/ai-strategy-consulting-firms/saudi-arabia/riyadh?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 3\. Where to start: my recommendations

**For AI strategy and a practical roadmap**

Start with **Bilytica, Sia Partners, or PIC**\. Ask each to identify high-value use cases, estimate ROI, assess data readiness, and create a phased implementation plan.

---

**For hands-on AI implementation**

Evaluate **Kindi, Open for AI, or Bilytica**\. Request a working proof of concept, integration plan, deployment timeline, and post-launch support commitments.

---

**For a large enterprise transformation**

Consider **Capgemini, Accenture, or Sia Partners**\. Assess their proposed delivery team, sector-specific experience, and ability to implement AI across multiple business functions.

## 4\. What to evaluate before selecting a partner

Use these criteria when issuing an RFP or interviewing shortlisted firms.

- **Business outcomes\:** Can they demonstrate measurable cost savings, revenue growth, productivity gains, or better customer experience?
- **Implementation capability\:** Do they build and deploy production systems, or mainly deliver strategy documents and presentations?
- **Saudi compliance\:** Can they address the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), relevant NDMO requirements, data residency, and sector-specific controls?
- **Knowledge transfer\:** Will your employees be able to manage and improve the solution after the engagement?
- **Commercial transparency\:** Are the roadmap, implementation milestones, licensing, cloud costs, and ongoing support clearly priced?
- **Relevant references\:** Can they provide comparable client examples and speak to measurable results?

For a first engagement, I would favour a **paid AI assessment followed by one or two production pilots**, rather than committing immediately to a company-wide transformation.
